greet.text: A big Deepfolk with a lamp-black beard, wiping down a counter cut from one block of stone. "The Lamp and Pick. Ale, stew, a bed at the back for those who've earned it. Hewers drink first; everyone else drinks after."

choices.text: What do the hewers talk about?

bed.text: "Ten gold and it's yours whenever you want it. Quiet, mostly. The rock hums at night. You'll get used to it."

talk.text: "Seams. Pay. Who's sleeping with whose guildmaster." He sets down a mug. "And the blind ones. Below the lowest gallery, under the ninth seam, my gran said there's a choir that sings in the dark and never stops, and anyone who hears the whole song comes up quiet. Gran said a lot of things. Gran also came up quiet."
